About AP Tech Agency

AI automation, with a team behind every step.

We help businesses turn customer conversations into useful next steps. AI automation is our main focus, supported by website development and UI/UX design. Led by founder and technical lead Nazmul Hasan, our five-person team works from Bangladesh.

Led by a developer

Nazmul Hasan

Founder & technical lead

Nazmul leads the technical work at AP Tech Agency. His development experience includes WordPress, Elementor, PHP and Laravel. He turns business needs into a practical build plan and helps the designers and developers bring it to life.

  • Understanding how your business works
  • Choosing a practical technical approach
  • Guiding development and preparing your team for launch

The team

Five people. One shared plan.

Two UI/UX designers, two developers and one analyst/project manager bring different skills to the same goal. Clear roles and regular review points help everyone work from the same plan.

How we think

Good work starts
with good decisions.

Start with your business

We ask about your customers, your goals and the work your team needs to do.

Make the plan clear

Your proposal sets out the features, responsibilities, review points and price.

Choose what is useful

We explain the options and choose tools that fit the job, your budget and the people using them.

Leave you ready to use it

We plan the files, access and guidance your team needs to manage the finished work.

A clear scope. A fixed project price.

You know what the project includes and what it costs before work starts. If the requirements change, we explain the extra work, price and effect on timing before proceeding. Hosting, paid tools and ongoing support are listed separately where they apply.
